description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an applied AI team working across forward deployed engineering, research, and product. You will help enterprise organizations turn complex challenges into deployable AI systems, including RL-based agents, while shaping the tools and platform behind them.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work directly with enterprise leaders to identify valuable use cases and translate them into AI systems that support the core platform.

 - Train and fine-tune models, build agents, develop evaluation frameworks, and create reinforcement learning environments for enterprise domains.

 - Bring patterns and insights from production deployments into product toolkits and abstractions.

 - Lead technical discovery with senior stakeholders and scope solutions to ambiguous business problems.

 - Explain model behavior clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience in applied machine learning, reinforcement learning, product engineering, or technical consulting involving the development or deployment of AI systems.

 - Model-level machine learning understanding and hands-on experience deploying AI to solve real-world problems.

 - Knowledge of ML evaluation, training, and problem decomposition, with experience in reinforcement learning or evaluation frameworks a plus.

 - Software engineering skills and proficiency in Python, Java, C++, TypeScript, or JavaScript.

 - Experience conducting technical discovery with senior stakeholders, scoping AI systems, and communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

 - Background in computer science, mathematics, software engineering, physics, machine learning, or data science.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $140,000 to $300,000 annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York, United States.
